text: Long night. I can't sleep thinking about the TFG submission. I look at what my classmates are doing and feel like I'm really behind, even though I don't actually know if that's true. I've been saying for days that I'm going to write to Jordi to tell him how I'm doing, and I don't do it because I'm embarrassed to show him something that's not finished. I think the problem isn't the work, it's that I don't tell anyone how I'm feeling. Tomorrow I'm definitely going to write to him. I also want to leave my phone out of the room because when I can't sleep, I end up looking at things that make me feel worse.
points: I will write to Jordi tomorrow.
I don't share my feelings with anyone.
I want to leave my phone out of the room.
